# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1487
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1487
- **Title**: fix(1365): anchor the countdown drain on the full drained row; un-quarantine the suite
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1365-jobs-countdown-flake` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +17
- **Deletions**: -43
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T12:08:11Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:19Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1487
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1487
- **Title**: fix(1365): anchor the countdown drain on the full drained row; un-quarantine the suite
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1365-jobs-countdown-flake` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +17
- **Deletions**: -43
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T12:08:11Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:19Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

## PR Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1487
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1487
- **Title**: fix(1365): anchor the countdown drain on the full drained row; un-quarantine the suite
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1365-jobs-countdown-flake` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +17
- **Deletions**: -43
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T12:08:11Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:19Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1487
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1487
- **Title**: fix(1365): anchor the countdown drain on the full drained row; un-quarantine the suite
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1365-jobs-countdown-flake` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +17
- **Deletions**: -43
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T12:08:11Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:19Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs
  pre-merge in ci.yml's `pty-visual` leg — gh-1538 retired the nightly
  duplicate — and on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet in the pre-merge SM

  `scripts/check_coverage.py 80` dispatch run; ci.yml has no

  diff-coverage arm in `coverage-gate` is reserve for a future real PR
  trigger); jscpd duplication < 1%

- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:19Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.

  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the

## PR Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1487
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1487
- **Title**: fix(1365): anchor the countdown drain on the full drained row; un-quarantine the suite
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1365-jobs-countdown-flake` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +17
- **Deletions**: -43
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T12:08:11Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:19Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

{
  "key": "pr-1487",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "fix(1365): anchor the countdown drain on the full drained row; un-quarantine the suite",
    "description": "Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)"
  }

  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe

## PR Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.

  pre-merge in ci.yml's `pty-visual` leg — gh-1538 retired the nightly
  duplicate — and on demand).

## Description

Fixes #1365

## Root cause (from the red-run job logs)

Every one of the 13 red runs predates the predicate-anchored drain wait (`08f01a27c`, PR #1345, landed 2026-10-07 02:53 UTC — 29 min after the newest red run). All 13 SHAs carried the old capture path: `waitForOutput(settleMs: 500)`, a SILENCE settle, over a scenario whose ten sleeps are staggered exactly 1 s apart (3..12 s) — one stretched inter-notice gap on a loaded runner satisfied the silence rule and returned the capture mid-drain:

- run 37555841005, job 112581953579, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..5}` (does not contain '6')
- run 37561842069, job 112600820385, `shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart 157:7`: `Actual: Set:{1..7}` (does not contain '8')

Verified the test file at `dc37d9cf` still had the silence settle. Since #1345, the drain waits on `settledJobNumbers(raw).length == 10` (unit-pinned in `pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart`) and every supervised nightly repeat run is green: 37723426881 (Oct 8 ✅), 37880055409 + 38021029680 (Oct 9/10 — countdown ✅ in both; their overall failures are unrelated tests).

## This PR

1. **Residual vacuous anchor killed**: `waitForScreen('0 running')` matched the still-full board instantly — the peak frame's `10 running` CONTAINS the substring `0 running` — so the drain-to-zero SCREEN proof anchored nothing and only held because the raw-side predicate plus the settle window happened to order the repaint first. The wait now anchors on the exact drained collapsed row (`Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost`) and asserts on the captured frame (gh-1049 contract; `pty_screen_wait_reg_test` guard stays green).
2. **Un-quarantine** (the issue's fix-PR contract): both stale `scripts/test_quarantine.json` entries for this test are removed — the closed #1346 entry and the #1365 entry (root cause fixed + repeat-run proof above). The suite rejoins the deterministic gate; `apply_quarantine.py --check` green (12 entries).

## Scope note

TUI-side test determinism only — no `lib/` change, `shell_jobs.dart` untouched (no overlap with the headless lane on PR #1463).

## Delivered

- [x] Root cause evidenced from red-run logs (FILE:LINE, both SHAs verified pre-fix)
- [x] Drain-to-zero screen wait anchored on the exact drained row (vacuous-substring match eliminated)
- [x] Both stale quarantine entries removed; gate re-admits the file (`apply_quarantine.py --check` green)
- [x] `dart analyze` zero issues; `dart format` clean; default-suite guards green (17 tests: `settledJobNumbers` predicate, `pollUntil`, FA_BIN seam, gh-1049/gh-1250 REG guards)
- [ ] PTY legs on CI (local host sandbox denies `openpty` — no PTY suite can spawn here; the un-quarantined file runs in shard 2/3 on this head)

  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.

  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.

  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.

# PR #1487 rework — drained-row const hoist (review thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6rD-p9`)

## Issues/Notes

- One open review thread with a targetable id was outstanding on this PR:
  `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6rD-p9` — *SUGGESTION: hoist the drained-row literal into a named const*. The
  drained row `'Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost'` was inlined twice (the
  `waitForScreen` anchor and the `contains` assertion) where the file's `_allRunning` const
  precedent keeps both sides in sync by construction. Fixed in this pass.
- The other two open entries in `pr_discussions_raw.json` (`Automated Code Review — APPROVE` and
  the `dmtools:review-verdict` record) carry `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` and are
  machine records, one explicitly marked *do not edit or reply* — they get no fabricated reply
  targets; no thread id was invented for them.
- Note for the validation leg: the PTY suite **does** spawn in this sandbox (`openpty` is
  available), so the un-quarantined countdown file was run end-to-end here, not only via the
  non-PTY guards.

## Approach

- Hoisted the literal into a documented file-level const directly below the `_allRunning`
  precedent (test/integration/shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart:62):

  ```dart
  /// The drained collapsed board row: all ten settled, nothing left running.
  const _allDrained = 'Background jobs (10) · 0 running · 10 done · 0 lost';
  ```

- Replaced both inline occurrences with the const: the drain anchor
  `await harness.waitForScreen(_allDrained, ...)` (line 187) and the captured-frame assertion
  `contains(_allDrained)` (line 192). Behavior-identical refactor — no new logic, no scope
  growth; the anchor row, quarantine removals, and drain predicate from the original PR are
  untouched.
- Baseline-then-verify: ran the PTY suite on the pre-edit head first (green), applied the hoist,
  then re-ran the same suite on the edited head to prove behavior preservation.

## Files Modified

- `test/integration/shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart` — `+const _allDrained` (lines 61–62);
  anchor and assertion now reference the const (+3/−2 lines).

## Test Coverage

- `dart test test/integration/shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart --tags integration` — **1/1
  green on the edited head** (and green on the pre-edit baseline); the drain-to-zero screen wait
  on the exact `_allDrained` row is exercised end-to-end through a real PTY.
- `dart test test/integration/pty_harness_settled_jobs_test.dart test/integration/pty_screen_wait_reg_test.dart`
  — **7/7 green** (the `settledJobNumbers` drain predicate and gh-1049 `waitForScreen` REG
  guards).
- `dart analyze test/integration/shell_job_countdown_pty_test.dart` — no issues;
  `dart format` — 0 changed.
- `python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py --check` — green (`Quarantine list OK`, 11 entries; the
  countdown file carries none — both stale entries stay removed on this merged-main head).

shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.

shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /

  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe

  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;

    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via

  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
